LESSON: DIMENSIONING

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.2: Dimensioning

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Dimensioning. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is dimensioning applied in drawings?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
2. draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: DIMENSIONING
This lesson teaches Dimensioning for Grade 8 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Dimensioning using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Dimensioning above.
2. Explain Dimensioning to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Dimensioning.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Dimensioning with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Dimensioning important for a Grade 8 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is dimensioning applied in drawings?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the types of dimensioning in drawing
2. draw lines used for dimensioning in drawing

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
